about: Test 15 of docs/plans/0003-mcp.md. Each question goes to `claude -p` with khi-mcp on the evaluation Library (fixture.json) and no other tools. The prompt suffix asks for a last line `RESULT {json}`. The judge compares that JSON with `expect`: sets of ids compare as sets, numbers exactly, `mustNotInclude` ids must be absent. Written before any code exists (2026-11-24).
promptSuffix: Use only the khi tools. End your answer with one line: RESULT followed by a JSON object with the keys you were asked for (highlightIds as an array of highlight ids, numbers as an object, readers as an array of names). Use [] or {} when there is nothing.

questions.ask: Que destaques novos tem o Bruno que ainda não viu na app? Keys: highlightIds.
questions.checks: unseen follows the app rule: Duly Noted was opened after the second sync; first-sync highlights are never new

questions.checks: syncedSince does not depend on opening the book

questions.checks: search in notes only; sap-01 has «rever» in the text, not in a note; «Rever» with a capital matches

questions.ask: Quantos destaques tem a Ana de cada autor? Keys: numbers, with the author names as keys.
questions.checks: exact counts across two books by the same author
